title: Hover, selected, focus and disabled layers on a highlighted row

steps.do: Move the mouse over the highlighted Work row
steps.expected: The hover layer shows over the row and the highlight FFFB8F is still visible under it (not replaced)
steps.why: Row 8 (04-Test1, Work Breakdown) highlighted FFFB8F via Highlight Row, no Save. Hovered cell class 'hover': background-color rgb(255,251,143) kept, extra layer rgba(24,144,255,0.14) on top. Same as previous run. Mixed colour: a person judges the picture.

steps.do: Click the row to select it
steps.expected: The selected look shows and the highlight is still visible
steps.why: Double-click on No. cell gives row class b-selected; cells keep background-color rgb(255,251,143), selected layer rgba(24,144,255,0.08). A single click selects only one cell. Mixed colour: a person judges the picture.

steps.do: Click a cell of the row so it has focus
steps.expected: The focus look shows and the highlight is still visible
steps.why: Clicked Description cell: class selected+focused, bg stays rgb(255,251,143), layer rgba(24,144,255,0.08) on that cell only, outline 3px in text colour (rgb(89,89,89)); other cells no layer. Highlight kept; focus look is a visual call.

steps.do: Click an empty area of the page
steps.expected: The row looks like FFFB8F again
steps.why: After clicking empty area (700,40): all cells bg rgb(255,251,143), no layer except the Description cell, which stays selected+focused (rgba(24,144,255,0.08)). Not fully back to plain FFFB8F: a person decides.

steps.do: Record how the disabled cell of the Platform row looks with no highlight
steps.expected: The look is written down for comparison
steps.why: Platform row FP, read-only cell (col 4, class b-readonly-cell): background-color rgb(242,248,250), layer rgb(245,245,245), text rgb(89,89,89). Recorded.

steps.do: Right-click the Platform row, open Highlight Row and choose B9E0FF
steps.why: Menu has no B9E0FF: the light-blue swatch is rgb(186,224,255) = BAE0FF; row cells measured bg rgb(186,224,255) (B9E0FF = 185,224,255, 1 off in red). Previous run recorded rgb(185,224,255), now 186. Colour is the same blue in the picture, but the code in the step differs: person decides (likely step text typo, or palette changed with the new build).

steps.expected: The disabled look is still visible, mixed with the highlight, and the cell is still recognised as disabled
steps.why: Cell keeps class b-readonly-cell, layer rgb(245,245,245) and text rgb(89,89,89) over bg rgb(186,224,255), plus selected layer rgba(24,144,255,0.08). Mixed colour, no exact value: a person judges the picture.

steps.do: Right-click the Platform row, open Highlight Row and choose No Color, then reload without Save
steps.expected: The disabled cell looks as in step 5
steps.why: After No Color and reload without Save: 0 highlighted cells; disabled cell bg rgb(242,248,250), layer rgb(245,245,245), text rgb(89,89,89) = identical to step 5. Row 8 also back to rgb(255,255,255). Picture taken after reload.
